newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-BLACKBURN DENY SIGNING SAMPDORIA'S ERIKSSON.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BLACKBURN DENY SIGNING SAMPDORIA'S ERIKSSON.

text.p: English premier league club Blackburn on Wednesday denied reports that Sven Goran Eriksson had quit Italian club Sampdoria to become their new manager.

"We seem to hear and read something different every day but we are carrying on as normal," said caretaker-manager Tony Parkes said. "The club has told me I will be the first to know when anything is decided."
Italian newspapers reported Eriksson had agreed to a five-year contract.
Blackburn are looking for a new coach to replace Ray Harford who resigned almost seven weeks ago.
